_comment: ONE RULE PER BOUNDARY — the shared fixture of the section-boundary parity lock
(task-a4d1ae76fdb2a6b0). A `section` container used to open AND close on a
full-width rule, so two adjacent sections stacked two lines where the grammar
wants one. The Elixir engine settled the grammar in #16233: an UNTITLED
stack-mode section whose first child is a heading draws NO rule pair at all —
the heading itself carries the boundary (paper-surface.css gives a container
head the same 92px beat / 2px rule / 16px gap a top-level h2 gets, #15806).
Every OTHER shape keeps the pair: a bold title needs a rule above it to read
as a head, and a grid-mode section is a layout box, not a chapter.
THREE ENGINES READ THIS ONE FILE — never three generated mirrors, which drift
the moment one side is regenerated and the others are not:
Elixir  api/lib/barkpark/portable_doc/render/section_layout.ex stack_rules?/2
api/test/barkpark/portable_doc/render/section_boundary_rules_parity_test.exs
Go      internal/pdrender/blocks.go sectionStackRules
internal/pdrender/section_boundary_rules_parity_test.go
JS      js/packages/react/src/blocks/core.ts sectionStackRules
js/packages/react/tests/section-boundary-rules.parity.test.ts
`rules` is the number of BOUNDARY rules the section draws around its body: the
web engines count `<hr class="bp-hr"` and the TUI counts full-width `─` lines.
Children are deliberately level-2/3 headings and paragraphs only — a level-1
heading draws its own underline in the TUI and an `hr` child would draw a rule
of its own, either of which would corrupt the count.

cases.name: untitled section opening on a level-2 heading — the heading IS the boundary
untitled section opening on a level-3 heading — the predicate is the TYPE, not the level
an explicitly null title is an ABSENCE, not a title
untitled section opening on a paragraph — no head to carry the boundary, keep the pair

blocks.text: A head that is not first

cases.name: titled section opening on a heading — the bold title needs the rule above it
titled section opening on a paragraph
an EMPTY-STRING title is a title — the gate is nil, not blankness
grid-mode section opening on a heading — a layout box is not a chapter, keep the pair
a section with an EMPTY blocks list draws its pair
a section with NO blocks key at all draws its pair
